name: youtube-channel-flashdata
description: Read a YouTube channel profile and recent videos by handle. Capture channel identifiers and a bounded recent-upload inventory. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_channel enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
